subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

SCRAWNY
solution:
The correct answer is: Skinny

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Scrawny means very thin because not fed enough so that you can see the shape of the bones under the skin.

 
 
• Example - *After going without food for a long time, the man looked pale and **scrawny**.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Skinny means very thin, especially in a way that you find unpleasant or ugly.
 
 
• Example - *He was as **skinny **as a stick, in his early twenties*.
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Scrawny' and 'Skinny' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Heavy means weighing a lot; difficult to lift or move.
 
• Plump is used for a person or an animal, pleasantly fat.
 
• Chubby means slightly fat in a pleasant way.
